engineering_judgment.definition: The capacity to make good technical decisions under uncertainty, weighing trade-offs that no rule can settle.

mon_exchange_rate.definition: The price of one currency expressed in the money of another currency.
mon_exchange_rate.example: Ask which day the exchange rate belongs to, because the number is only true for that day.

war_fog_of_war.definition: The state of not knowing: incomplete reports, false information and the general uncertainty of events.
war_fog_of_war.example: In the fog of war the commander acted on a report three days old.
